title: Eligibility
description: Who can get an offer, where, with what proof, and for how long (Eligibility PRD, Chapter 4). Referenced from resource.schema.json.

audience.description: resident = anyone living in the listed countries (national promotions). public = anyone at all (e.g. free courses open to everybody); use it only together with a country rule or for offers that are not otherwise free-for-all on Freemeans.

items.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, upper case (PK, US, GB).

source_url.description: Page that lists the countries, when it differs from the main source.

via.description: institution = the school, university or organization applies, not the person (Workspace for Education, HEC Digital Library).

verifier.description: Third party that checks status, e.g. SheerID, Goodstack, TechSoup.

excludes.description: Who is explicitly not eligible, in plain words.

notes.description: Practical notes, e.g. whether .edu.pk addresses pass automatic checks. Never a workaround.

redeem_by.description: Last day to claim. After it the offer is shown as ended.

access_ends.description: Fixed date when free access stops for everyone, e.g. 'free through June 2027'.

duration_months.description: Length of the free period from the day it is claimed.

renewable.description: Can be claimed again (e.g. every year while still a student).

price.description: What it costs after the free period, as the provider states it.

auto_renews.description: true = charged automatically unless cancelled. Requires the auto_renews_paid badge.

text.description: Exact phrase the source check expects on the page: a date, amount or condition.
